name: The First Frostbell
objective: Search the Keep's flooded vault for the first Frostbell — the one the Director could not carry.
intro: The vault is waist-deep in freezing water. Something in the dark is ringing, very softly, in a rhythm like breathing.
dialogue: Researcher: "Six bells, rung as one — the old texts call it the Winter Chorus. Every record ends the same way: 'and the heart remembered'."
Researcher: "Take it. But listen — when you hold it, you'll hear something breathing under the mountain. That's normal. I think."
lore_discovery: The first Frostbell is recovered. When held, the player can faintly hear something enormous exhaling beneath Frostpine.
